ask.label: You ask
ask.detail: You describe what you want in your own words. There is no command to learn: the kernel recognises the intent.

kernel.label: Kernel
kernel.detail: CLAUDE.md, the only part loaded in every session: the prime directives, the operating loop and the menu of skills and agents.

router.label: Router
router.sub: loads only what the task needs
router.detail: ROUTER.md is a generated map. It pulls in the few core docs and field-pack files this task needs and leaves the rest on disk.

skill.label: A skill
skill.detail: A workflow that runs in the same conversation: build, debug, qa and the rest. One job each, picked from what you asked.

agent.label: An agent
agent.detail: A role that works in its own clean context and reports back, so a review is not graded by the context that wrote the code.

verify.label: Verify
verify.detail: The work is run and checked before handoff. A claim with no tool result behind it is reported as not checked.

verdict.label: Verdict
verdict.detail: Every report closes with one of four verdicts in plain words, the evidence for it, and a line naming what was not checked.

core.label: Universal core
core.detail: Field-agnostic documents read on demand: the mindset, the decision framework, the rigor gate and the execution loop.

field.label: Field pack
field.detail: What to know and which tools, for one real stack. None ships: init detects the stack and builds the pack from the template.

skills.label: Skills
skills.detail: A growable library of workflows. Each is one job with a short routing description and a body that loads only when it runs.

agents.label: Agents
agents.detail: Few and deep. Each runs in a fresh context: design, review, restructuring, and adopt-or-build decisions.

cli.label: CLI
cli.detail: Installs the brain and answers an assistant mid-task: the routing table, one skill, one agent, the wrong-log. The lookups are read-only.

hooks.label: Hooks
hooks.detail: A short note at session start that points at the kernel, so the brain is present even where nothing else carries it.

mod.label: The Mod
mod.detail: Opt-in code that enforces what the kernel asks for: one question before anything that cannot be undone. It only tightens.

claude.label: Claude Code
claude.detail: Reads .claude/CLAUDE.md on its own at the start of every session and again after compaction. Skills and agents are native.

claude-kernel.label: .claude/CLAUDE.md
claude-kernel.detail: The kernel, loaded natively and re-read after compaction. An existing file gets a pointer appended, never overwritten.

claude-skills.label: .claude/skills
claude-skills.detail: Every skill linked where Claude Code discovers skills, so it picks one from its description or by name.

claude-agents.label: .claude/agents
claude-agents.detail: The isolated-context roles as native subagents: design, review, restructuring, adopt or build.

claude-hook.label: SessionStart hook
claude-hook.detail: One entry merged into .claude/settings.json. It carries the framing at session start; every other key is left as it was.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.detail: Has no kernel file of its own, so the kernel rides in a rule that Cursor sends again with every request.

cursor-rule.label: .cursor/rules/mastermind.mdc
cursor-rule.detail: alwaysApply: true with the kernel inlined. It is re-sent on every request, so nothing has to survive compaction.

cursor-agents.label: .cursor/agents
cursor-agents.detail: Generated copies of the agents as Cursor subagents, so a review runs in its own context there too.

cursor-hook.label: sessionStart hook
cursor-hook.detail: Wired to Cursor's published schema, and unverified: Cursor has open bug reports where a hook's context never reaches the model. The rule carries the weight.

codex.label: Codex
codex.detail: Reads AGENTS.md once at startup, after you trust the project. A hook brings the framing back when context is compacted.

codex-agents-md.label: AGENTS.md
codex-agents-md.detail: The instruction file Codex reads at startup. It carries the kernel; an AGENTS.md of your own gets the kernel in a marked block after your content.

codex-skills.label: .agents/skills
codex-skills.detail: Every skill linked where Codex discovers skills, picked by its description or by $name.

codex-hook.label: SessionStart hook
codex-hook.detail: Restores the framing after compaction, which AGENTS.md alone does not. Inert until you approve it once.

brain.label: .mastermind/
brain.detail: The project's own copy of the brain: kernel, core, field pack, skills, agents. Every tool's wiring points here.

flow.title: How a request flows
flow.summary: From what you type to a verdict you can trust.

install.title: What an install writes
install.summary: Three tools, three ways of loading, one brain in your project.

layers.title: The layers
layers.summary: One small kernel is always loaded. Everything under it loads when a task calls for it.

spec.title: Spec-driven, in order
spec.summary: For a feature that spans sessions or touches money, authentication or data.
